coolingOff.prohibited: In accordance with regulations, Internal Auditors are prohibited from testing activities that were previously their responsibility (as Line 1 or Line 2) before a cooling-off period of at least 12 months has passed.

gatekeeper.csaIneffectiveTitle: Line 3 Testing Suspended (SK-5 BAB V p. 54)
gatekeeper.csaIneffectiveDescription: Based on Line 1 CSA and/or Line 2 validation, this control was concluded as Ineffective. In accordance with Chapter V Point 1.2 Item 3, Line 3 does not perform testing until the control is declared Effective through remediation.
